categories.main_business_segments: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. (ARE) operates as a real estate investment trust (REIT) primarily focused on owning, operating, and developing Class A properties clustered in urban campuses for the life science, agtech, and technology industries. The company’s business is centered on collaborative campuses in major innovation clusters, with a single reportable segment: ownership, operation, development, and redevelopment of office/laboratory, agtech, and tech office properties.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: ARE specializes in the development and redevelopment of high-quality, generic, and reusable office/laboratory spaces with advanced infrastructure such as reinforced concrete floors, heavy-duty HVAC, enhanced environmental controls, and upgraded utilities. The company emphasizes sustainable building practices, targeting LEED Gold or Platinum certifications, and incorporates advanced design for flexibility, energy efficiency, and resilience to climate risks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ARE’s primary customers are tenants in the life science, agtech, and technology sectors, including multinational pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, medical device companies, digital health and tech companies, academic and medical research institutions, government research agencies, non-profits, and venture capital firms. The company’s properties are designed to serve organizations seeking collaborative, innovative environments in leading research and technology hubs.
categories.geographic_coverage: ARE’s operations are concentrated in key North American innovation clusters: Greater Boston, San Francisco Bay Area, New York City, San Diego, Seattle, Maryland, and Research Triangle. The company also has a small presence in Canada and China. As of December 31, 2021, ARE owned or had interests in 414 properties totaling approximately 43.7 million rentable square feet.
categories.supply_chain_position: ARE operates downstream in the real estate supply chain as a landlord, developer, and operator of specialized office/laboratory and tech office space. The company provides finished, ready-to-occupy, and customizable space to end users (tenants) and does not engage in the manufacturing or supply of building materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, ARE focuses on maximizing long-term asset value and shareholder returns through internal and external growth, with a unique emphasis on clustering Class A properties in AAA innovation locations. The company invests in sustainable development, wellness, and productivity enhancements, and leverages its venture capital platform to support innovation in life sciences, agtech, and technology. ARE is committed to ESG leadership, climate resilience, and continuous improvement in building efficiency and tenant experience.
categories.revenue_model: ARE generates revenue primarily through rental income from long-term leases with tenants, with approximately 91% of leases structured as triple net, requiring tenants to pay most operating expenses. Additional revenue streams include tenant recoveries, capital expenditure recapture, and, to a lesser extent, income from non-real estate investments and venture capital activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ARE competes with other office/laboratory and tech office landlords, including REITs, insurance companies, pension funds, private equity, developers, and institutional investors. Many competitors have substantial financial resources, but ARE differentiates itself as the first and leading publicly traded REIT focused on life science, agtech, and technology campuses in top innovation clusters, maintaining strong industry relationships and a reputation for high-quality, collaborative environments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2021, ARE had a total market capitalization of $44.0 billion and an asset base of 67.0 million square feet in North America. The company reported total revenues of $2.1 billion for 2021, up 12.1% year-over-year, with net income attributable to common stockholders of $563.4 million and funds from operations (FFO) of $1.14 billion. ARE has demonstrated strong leasing activity, high occupancy (94%), and a robust development pipeline, supporting a growth trajectory driven by demand for specialized space in innovation hubs.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ARE’s value proposition centers on providing world-class, collaborative, and flexible office/laboratory environments in premier innovation locations, enabling tenants to recruit and retain top talent and drive scientific and technological breakthroughs. The company emphasizes sustainable, resilient, and wellness-focused buildings, long-term tenant relationships, and a proven track record of high occupancy, stable cash flows, and industry-leading tenant quality. Its integrated approach, including venture capital support, further differentiates ARE as a strategic partner to innovative organizations.
